units.source_text: 啊，写完这一百页稿纸的时候，祖父的身体，祖父不幸的病体，不知会变成什么样子呢？

en.t: Ah, when I have finished writing these hundred pages of manuscript paper, what will have become of Grandfather's body, of his poor, unfortunate sick body?

units.source_text: （我准备了一百张稿纸，打算写这样的日记，一直写到一百页。

en.t: I prepared one hundred sheets of manuscript paper, intending to write this kind of diary until I had filled one hundred pages.

units.source_text: 我担心祖父会不会在我还没写到一百页时就作古了。

en.t: I was afraid that Grandfather might pass away before I had written as far as the hundredth page.

units.source_text: 不知怎的，我有这种心情：日记写到一百页，祖父可能就会得救……

en.t: Somehow, I had the feeling that if the diary reached one hundred pages, Grandfather might be saved...

units.source_text: 另一方面，我想在祖父弥留之际，至少用这种日记的形式，把他的音容笑貌记录下来。）

en.t: On the other hand, I wanted, at the time of Grandfather's final moments, at least to record his voice, appearance, and smile in the form of this diary.
